selected_beats.action_beat: Elena stands elegantly in her emerald velvet gown while Kaelen is visible beside her in his formal midnight-blue military uniform, his brass automaton arm catching the warm light of a massive crystal chandelier.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Wide shot, low angle looking up at the opulent vaulted ceiling and chandeliers to emphasize grandeur.

selected_beats.action_beat: Kaelen's gleaming brass automaton arm is raised in a defensive posture, deflecting the first volley of humming voltaic rapiers from masked figures emerging from deep balcony shadows.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, high contrast lighting emphasizing the sparks and mechanical detail against the dark background.

selected_beats.action_beat: During a fierce clash on the slippery metal grating, Elena is seen reacting to an energy blade grazing her cheek; she fiercely disarms the attacker as rain pours down around them.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Cinematic wide shot from above, emphasizing the height and misty city abyss below during the stormy twilight.

character_attire.Elena: reinforced black tactical combat armor with padded pauldrons and utility belts

selected_beats.action_beat: Elena stands in reinforced black tactical combat armor with a prominent new jagged crimson scar across her left cheek; Kaelen stands steadfast beside her in his rain-drenched charcoal duster, his brass prosthetic gleaming. They look out over the liberated city as daybreak breaks through the mist.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, cinematic framing emphasizing the contrast between Elena's dark armor and Kaelen's polished brass against the soft morning light of dawn.
